findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_coaching_brain" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_personal_coach, update_place, answer_held_request, verify_place_claim, set_booking_notices, get_gym_billing_link, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Private data: preview_workout_import, save_workout_to_phorme, preview_program_import, save_program_to_phorme, get_training_history, claim_place · Public sink: check_place_in_ai, send_note_to_my_members, get_my_brain_code, get_gym_report, update_place, publish_place, answer_held_request, claim_place, verify_place_claim, publish_gym_brain, set_booking_notices, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Destructive: get_saved_training, plan_for_race, cover_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_personal_coach, update_place, answer_held_request, verify_place_claim, set_booking_notices, get_gym_billing_link, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Private data: preview_workout_import, save_workout_to_phorme, preview_program_import, save_program_to_phorme, get_training_history, claim_place · Public sink: check_place_in_ai, send_note_to_my_members, get_my_brain_code, get_gym_report, update_place, publish_place, answer_held_request, claim_place, verify_place_claim, publish_gym_brain, set_booking_notices, get_payout_setup_link, set_owner_email · Destructive: get_saved_training, plan_for_race, cover_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_coaching_brain" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the user wants a way to train for a goal or sport, for example "I want to get more explosive for basketball", "build muscle three days a week" or "train for a half marathon", and has not picked a programme. Phorme coaching brains are curated training methods: a coach, the principles th" → after: "Use this when the user wants a way to train for a goal or sport, for example "I want to get more explosive for basketball", "build muscle three days a week" or "train for a half marathon", or wants to train with a named coach, for example "train with Cameron Goodson", and has not picked a programme,"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
